policy.translation: output-only; limitations are retained, never ignored
policy.interpolation: linear, monotonic sweep segments matched by ordinal
policy.metricsFields: Legacy spiceTs means target engine; ngspice means reference engine. In corpus mode target=ngspice, reference=Xyce.
policy.timing: single execution wall time, includes startup/output; not a performance benchmark

totals.reason: spice-ts and ngspice currently use MOS1 for LEVEL=260
